question: Can a learner trained on raw English/Japanese/Brazilian-Portuguese/Mathematics surfaces plus bounded teacher theater annotations reconstruct participant-indexed KFS and temporal relation structure on held-out raw surfaces, then use that reconstructed state to improve relation transfer over the prefrozen surface baselines?

stages.input: face-specific microepisodes independent of target relation sentences
held-out relation×face raw surface + learned grounding state
stages.claim_limit: does not establish surface referent binding

stages.input: matched lexical inventory with participant/KFS assignment permutations
stages.output: surface referents bound to opaque indexed participants and local KFS

stages.input: same participants + same event inventory under order/history permutations

stages.output: predicted theater state + retained residuals + relation disposition

prerequisites: bounded causal improvement over relevant controls

anti_cheat: matched structure cardinalities are identical across relations
teacher theater target inaccessible at evaluation
target relation sentences excluded from independent grounding curriculum
surface labels and project names are not semantic evidence
exact translation is neither required nor sufficient
same atom inventory with different participant binding must remain distinguishable
same event inventory with different temporal order must remain distinguishable
claim_fence: A pass may establish only bounded theater-state reconstruction and transfer at the tested curriculum scope. It does not establish unrestricted language understanding, cultural cognition, AGI, consciousness, or linguistic determinism.

identifiability_repair.problem: The original relation×face holdout can conflate missing face-specific lexical grounding with failure to reconstruct Theater. Withholding a relation cell may also withhold the only examples grounding relation-specific lexical material in that face.
identifiability_repair.rule: Ground reusable lexical/formal atoms independently of the four target relation templates, then test Theater binding and Music/order under interventions that hold lexical inventory approximately fixed.
